monitor_the_situation.title: Three Palestinians Injured in Settler Attack Near Nablus
— S3 · Conflict · Nablus, West Bank, Palestine · 32m ago. Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians near Nablus in the West Bank, leaving three injured amid rising settler violence in the territory.
UN Says Drone Strikes Drive Most Civilian Deaths in Sudan

— S3 · Conflict · Khartoum, Sudan · 57m ago. The United Nations reports over 80% of civilian deaths in Sudan this year come from drone attacks, signaling a worsening conflict as aerial strikes intensify.
Israeli Military Mistakenly Launches Interceptor in Southern Lebanon

— S3 · Conflict · Southern Lebanon · 1h ago. The Israeli military confirmed it mistakenly launched an interceptor missile at its own forces' fire in southern Lebanon, indicating a potential friendly fire incident.
